'''''Phasma''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Delilah S. Dawson]] as part of [[Journey to Star Wars: The Last Jedi|Journey to ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'']]. It tells the origins of [[Captain]] [[Phasma]] of the [[First Order]] prior to the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'']]. The novel was first published by [[Del Rey]] on [[September 1]], [[2017]] in hardcover, and was released in paperback on [[April 24]], [[2018]].
